$description: What is enforced vs convention for token use in PageSpecs. Enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py (rules TOKEN_*).

pageSpecStyleFields.theme: enum light|dark (must be one of the section contract's themes)

unsupportedFontsNote: font.mono and font.serif are catalogued but reserved for terminal/label artwork and the serif fallback stack; a PageSpec may not select them. Any family not in the catalog is rejected.

rawValueRestrictions.color: no hex/rgb/hsl/oklch literals anywhere in a PageSpec (TOKEN_RAW_COLOR)
rawValueRestrictions.space: no px/rem/em literals in style fields (TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING)

convention: type roles, radii, elevations, gradients and easing are applied by the section/component contracts, not chosen per PageSpec
maxWordsRule: Every text field's maxWords = ceil(1.25 x the largest word count measured for that role on the rendered clone at 1440px (extraction/measured-values.json -> sectionHeights[].textStats)), minimum 2. Recorded per field in the section contract.
